subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these fourteen new pinned third-party GitHub Action commits across secret-bearing and release/automation workflows after a current-base merge-result check?
rationale: This is an intentional supply-chain acceptance decision: the repository can verify that the references remain pinned and input-compatible, but only the workflow/security owner can approve executing the new upstream action code in these privileged paths.

options.title: Accept after current-base verification
options.body: Review the updated action commits and merge-result workflow runs, then merge if the owner accepts the upstream supply-chain changes.

options.title: Split or defer sensitive revisions
options.body: Keep routine action updates separate and defer any revision whose upstream security or behavior change needs deeper owner review.

recommendation.title: Accept after current-base verification
recommendation.body: Review the updated action commits and merge-result workflow runs, then merge if the owner accepts the upstream supply-chain changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context does not provide defensible individual file ownership; this decision belongs with the repository’s workflow/security owner.
